text: {"claims":[{"quote":"target to expand volumes of smartphone camera modules from 40 million units in this fiscal to 190 million to 200 million units per annum","metric":"volume growth","promised":"expand camera module volumes to 190‑200 million units per year","horizon":"next fiscal year"},{"quote":"We still feel that we should be able to have a margin of somewhere between 2.8% to 3.1%, 3.2% in our mobile phone business","metric":"margin","promised":"mobile phone margin of 2.8‑3.2%","horizon":"next 12 months"},{"quote":"We will do a capex of closer to INR1,100 crores, INR1,150-odd crores","metric":"capex","promised":"capex of roughly INR1.1‑1.15 billion","horizon":"this fiscal year"},{"quote":"We feel we should be closing at almost INR5,500 crores, INR6,000 crores in the current fiscal","metric":"revenue growth","promised":"export revenue of INR5.5‑6.0 billion","horizon":"current fiscal year"},{"quote":"We will scale up our capacity by operationalizing a new upcoming Chennai facility by end of Q4 of the current fiscal","metric":"store or capacity additions","promised":"new Chennai facility operational by end of Q4","horizon":"end of Q4 current fiscal"},{"quote":"This year, we should have revenues close to INR5,200 crores in telecom","metric":"revenue growth","promised":"telecom revenue of about INR5.2 billion","horizon":"this fiscal year"}]}
